<solution task="t1-palindromes">
tosedo normalize(c)
    wesosa ((c >= "A") dilisyo (c <= "Z")) {
        sheye upper <- "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";
        sheye lower <- "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz";
        sheye i <- 0;
        veshim (upper[i] <> c) {
            i <- i + 1;
        }
        cha lower[i];
    }
    wesosa (((c >= "a") dilisyo (c <= "z")) emsoulve ((c >= "0") dilisyo (c <= "9"))) {
        cha c;
    }
    cha malwe;
bawoum tosedo

tosedo palindrome(line)
    sheye left <- 0;
    sheye right <- louwo(line) - 1;
    veshim (left < right) {
        sheye a <- normalize(line[left]);
        wesosa (a = malwe) {
            left <- left + 1;
            chidrom;
        }
        sheye b <- normalize(line[right]);
        wesosa (b = malwe) {
            right <- right - 1;
            chidrom;
        }
        wesosa (a <> b) {
            cha ishe;
        }
        left <- left + 1;
        right <- right - 1;
    }
    cha shilsa;
bawoum tosedo

sheye line <- diwela();
veshim (line <> malwe) {

<solution task="t2-bignum">
tosedo chunks(line, first, past)
    sheye values <- [];
    sheye i <- past;
    veshim (i > first) {
        sheye value <- 0;
        sheye place <- 1;
        sho (sheye j <- 0; (j < 4) dilisyo (i > first); j <- j + 1) {
            i <- i - 1;
            value <- value + (place * odresdra(line[i]));
            place <- place * 10;
        }
        omse(values, value);
    }
    cha values;
bawoum tosedo

tosedo add(a, b)
    sheye values <- [];
    sheye carry <- 0;
    sho (sheye i <- 0; (i < louwo(a)) emsoulve (i < louwo(b)); i <- i + 1) {
        sheye value <- carry;
        wesosa (i < louwo(a)) {
            value <- value + a[i];
        }
        wesosa (i < louwo(b)) {
            value <- value + b[i];
        }
        omse(values, value drossou 10000);
        carry <- value / 10000;
    }
    wesosa (carry > 0) {
        omse(values, carry);
    }
    cha values;
bawoum tosedo

tosedo multiply(a, b)
    sheye values <- [];
    sho (sheye i <- 0; i < (louwo(a) + louwo(b)); i <- i + 1) {
        omse(values, 0);
    }
    sho (i <- 0; i < louwo(a); i <- i + 1) {
        sheye carry <- 0;
        sho (sheye j <- 0; j < louwo(b); j <- j + 1) {
            sheye k <- i + j;
            sheye value <- values[k] + ((a[i] * b[j]) + carry);
            values[k] <- value drossou 10000;
            carry <- value / 10000;
        }
        values[i + louwo(b)] <- carry;
    }
    cha values;
bawoum tosedo

tosedo writeNumber(values)
    sheye i <- louwo(values) - 1;
    veshim (i > 0) {
        wesosa (values[i] <> 0) {
            bou;
        }
        i <- i - 1;
    }
    tivou values[i];
    sho (i <- i - 1; i >= 0; i <- i - 1) {
        sheye text <- ramou(values[i]);
        sho (sheye j <- louwo(text); j < 4; j <- j + 1) {
            tivou "0";
        }
        tivou text;
    }
bawoum tosedo

sheye line <- diwela();
veshim (line <> malwe) {
    sheye sep <- 0;
    veshim (line[sep] <> " ") {
        sep <- sep + 1;
    }
    sheye a <- chunks(line, 0, sep);
    sheye b <- chunks(line, sep + 1, louwo(line));
    writeNumber(add(a, b));
    tivou " ";
    writeNumber(multiply(a, b));
    wami "";
    line <- diwela();
}
</solution>

<solution task="t2-rpn">
tosedo integerToken(token)

    }

    sho (sheye i <- start; i < n; i <- i + 1) {
        sheye c <- token[i];
        wesosa ((c < "0") emsoulve (c > "9")) {

tosedo evaluate(line)
    sheye stack <- [];
    sheye size <- 0;
    sheye i <- 0;
    sheye n <- louwo(line);
    veshim (i < n) {
        wesosa (line[i] = " ") {
            i <- i + 1;
            chidrom;
        }
        sheye token <- "";
        veshim (i < n) {
            wesosa (line[i] = " ") {
                bou;
            }
            token <- token + line[i];
            i <- i + 1;
        }
        sheye value <- malwe;
        moumare amdre token
        amdre "+", "-", "*", "/", "%"
            wesosa (size < 2) {
                cha malwe;
            }
            sheye a <- stack[size - 2];
            sheye b <- stack[size - 1];
            size <- size - 2;
            moumare amdre token
            amdre "+"
                value <- a + b;
            amdre "-"
                value <- a - b;
            amdre "*"
                value <- a * b;
            amdre oli
                wesosa (b = 0) {
                    cha malwe;
                }
                sheye q <- a / b;
                wesosa ((q < 0) dilisyo ((a drossou b) <> 0)) {
                    q <- q + 1;
                }
                wesosa (token = "/") {
                    value <- q;
                } oli {
                    value <- a - (b * q);
                }
            bawoum moumare
        amdre oli
            value <- integerToken(token);
            wesosa (value = malwe) {
                cha malwe;
            }
        bawoum moumare
        wesosa (size = louwo(stack)) {
            omse(stack, value);
        } oli {
            stack[size] <- value;
        }
        size <- size + 1;
    }
    wesosa (size = 1) {
        cha stack[0];
    }
    cha malwe;
bawoum tosedo

tosedo lowerLetter(c, upper, lower)
    wesosa ((c >= "a") dilisyo (c <= "z")) {

        sheye lo <- 0;
        sheye hi <- 25;

            sheye mid <- (lo + hi) / 2;
            wesosa (upper[mid] < c) {
                lo <- mid + 1;

tosedo descend(node, c)
    sheye child <- node[0];
    veshim (child <> malwe) {
        wesosa (child[2] = c) {
            cha child;

        child <- child[1];

    child <- [malwe, node[0], c, 0, ""];

tosedo record(node, word, terminals)
    wesosa (node[3] = 0) {

bawoum tosedo

sheye upper <- "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ";
sheye lower <- "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz";
sheye root <- [malwe, malwe, "", 0, ""];
sheye terminals <- [];
sheye line <- diwela();
veshim (line <> malwe) {
    sheye node <- root;
    sheye word <- "";
    sho (sheye i <- 0; i < louwo(line); i <- i + 1) {
        sheye c <- lowerLetter(line[i], upper, lower);
        wesosa (c <> malwe) {
            node <- descend(node, c);
            word <- word + c;
        } oli wesosa (node <> root) {
            record(node, word, terminals);
            node <- root;
            word <- "";
        }
    }
    wesosa (node <> root) {
        record(node, word, terminals);
    }
    line <- diwela();
}

sho (sheye rank <- 0; rank < 10; rank <- rank + 1) {

<solution task="t3-bigdiv">
tosedo compare(a, b)
    sho (sheye i <- 0; i < louwo(a); i <- i + 1) {
        wesosa (a[i] < b[i]) {
            cha -1;
        }

tosedo subtract(a, b)
    sheye borrow <- 0;
    sho (sheye i <- louwo(a) - 1; i >= 0; i <- i - 1) {
        sheye digit <- a[i] - (b[i] + borrow);
        borrow <- 0;
        wesosa (digit < 0) {
            digit <- digit + 10;
            borrow <- 1;
        }
        a[i] <- digit;

tosedo divide(line)
    sheye sep <- 0;
    veshim (line[sep] <> " ") {
        sep <- sep + 1;
    }
    sheye divisor <- [0];
    sheye remainder <- [0];
    sho (sheye i <- sep + 1; i < louwo(line); i <- i + 1) {
        omse(divisor, odresdra(line[i]));
        omse(remainder, 0);
    }
    sheye n <- louwo(divisor);
    sheye multiples <- [];
    sho (sheye d <- 0; d <= 9; d <- d + 1) {
        sheye digits <- [];
        sho (sheye i <- 0; i < n; i <- i + 1) {
            omse(digits, 0);
        }
        sheye carry <- 0;
        sho (i <- n - 1; i >= 0; i <- i - 1) {
            sheye value <- (d * divisor[i]) + carry;
            digits[i] <- value drossou 10;
            carry <- value / 10;
        }
        omse(multiples, digits);
    }

    sheye started <- ishe;
    sho (sheye i <- 0; i < sep; i <- i + 1) {
        sho (sheye j <- 0; j < (n - 1); j <- j + 1) {
            remainder[j] <- remainder[j + 1];
        }
        remainder[n - 1] <- odresdra(line[i]);
        sheye lo <- 0;
        sheye hi <- 9;
        veshim (lo < hi) {
            sheye mid <- (lo + (hi + 1)) / 2;
            wesosa (compare(remainder, multiples[mid]) >= 0) {
                lo <- mid;
            } oli {
                hi <- mid - 1;
            }
        }
        wesosa (lo > 0) {
            subtract(remainder, multiples[lo]);
            started <- shilsa;
        }
        wesosa (started) {
            tivou lo;
        }
    }
    wesosa (drol started) {
        tivou "0";
    }
    tivou " ";
    sheye i <- 0;
    veshim (i < (n - 1)) {
        wesosa (remainder[i] <> 0) {
            bou;
        }
        i <- i + 1;
    }
    sho (; i < n; i <- i + 1) {
        tivou remainder[i];
    }
    wami "";
bawoum tosedo

sheye line <- diwela();
veshim (line <> malwe) {
    divide(line);
    line <- diwela();
}
</solution>
